data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Also test boundary cases for bridge_env_id: (1) bridge_env_id=None should also pass all events through (guard should handle None); (2) bridge_env_id='  ' (whitespace-only) - document explicitly in T2 whether guard is 'if not bridge_env_id' or 'if not bridge_env_id or not bridge_env_id.strip()'; (3) a non-empty bridge_env_id with an event whose env_id matches should still be filtered (regression guard for the normal path).
